__prompts__.title: Plug-in title, used as the menu name and the readme heading
__prompts__.author: Author name
__prompts__.github_organization: GitHub organization or user which owns the repository
__prompts__.github_username: GitHub username of the package maintainer
__prompts__.repo_name: Repository name, also the distribution name on PyPI
__prompts__.org_name: Top level Python package name, usually the organization (lowercase, no hyphens)
__prompts__.lib_name: Python package name for the library (lowercase, no hyphens)
__prompts__.release_date: Date of the initial release, or 'unreleased' until it is released
